lia: Opening a tiny PR to harmonize streaming+pagination+retry snippets across py/ts/go. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5055
sam: I can take python. prefer sync example first; add a one-line pointer to async.
lia: yep. show `with RedwoodClient()` for cleanup, jittered backoff (max 5 attempts), and a short billing note about page_size.
dena: i'll do the go variant: show context, iter.Next(ctx) loop, redwood.PageSize(50), and checking iter.Err() after the loop. will add a brief retry helper.
morgan: TS will use `for await` + generic param so snippet-tests pass; will include identical retry structure.
ci-bot: snippet-tests queued for PR #5055: docs-lint, links-check, snippet-typecheck.
lia: Assigning reviews: @sam (py), @morgan (ts), @dena (go). Merge when CI green and approvals in. Thanks!
